tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled mechanism support a coupled siphon-memory ODE, but the five pilot rows leave its parameters ambiguous. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to fit and discriminate the mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations are insufficient to reliably identify the five coupled parameters; the mechanism note calls for at least eight rows.
It does not resolve the mechanism’s parameter-identifiability ambiguity.
Neither accounts for the observed coupled transient lag and memory state.
